records.text: Owens said someone, whom she believed was at BuzzFeed, cut the UK event clip, stripped the question, and said she was justifying Hitler killing Jews
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Someone—and I believe it was someone at BuzzFeed—cut a clip of a video from the Q&A portion of that UK event. ... And they stripped the question that was asked of me. ... Again, I was green, so I didn't understand why suddenly they were sharing a clip, and they were saying that I was justifying Adolf Hitler killing Jews.

verification.notes: Verified as an accusation made by Owens, not as proof that BuzzFeed deceptively edited the material. In the episode Owens says she believed someone at BuzzFeed cut the Q&A clip, removed the question, and portrayed her as justifying Hitler killing Jews. BuzzFeed's own February 2019 article confirms that its reporters surfaced and publicized the London remarks, but the article also supplies the nationalism question, quotes the broader answer, and links a video described as the full answer. That source does not substantiate the alleged removal of context or the exact 'justifying killing Jews' characterization.
